leadText: Eiji (Japanese: エイジ) is one of the Ghost Masters located in the Sealed Fort, located on GR Island in Pokémon Trading Card Game 2: The Invasion of Team GR! Eiji can be found in the first of the nine statues in the main room. Players who defeat Eiji will obtain a Present Pack, which can consist of any card that can be found in a booster pack in the game.
plainText:
Eiji (Japanese: エイジ) is one of the Ghost Masters located in the Sealed Fort, located on GR Island in Pokémon Trading Card Game 2: The Invasion of Team GR! Eiji can be found in the first of the nine statues in the main room. Players who defeat Eiji will obtain a Present Pack, which can consist of any card that can be found in a booster pack in the game.

==Everybody's Friend Deck==
Everybody's Friend Deck (Japanese: みんなともだちデッキ) is the deck played by Eiji. The deck features various types of Pokémon and takes advantage of cards like and to swap in desired opponents and quickly take them out.
